title: Chip
description: Compact elements that represent an input, attribute or filter, optionally clickable or deletable.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A chip only needs a label.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Seven color schemes from the theme.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

icon-avatar.title: Icon and avatar
icon-avatar.description: Show an icon or an avatar before the label.

deletable.title: Deletable
deletable.description: Providing onDelete renders a delete button; customize it with deleteIcon and its accessible name with deleteLabel. The second chip is also clickable: the chip and its delete button are two separate buttons.

clickable.title: Clickable and selected
clickable.description: clickable renders the content as a focusable native button activated with Enter or Space; selected highlights the active filter and is exposed as aria-pressed.

states.title: Loading and disabled
states.description: loading shows a spinner; disabled hides the delete button and blocks clicks.

ChipProps.label: Text of the chip
ChipProps.onDelete: Called when the delete button is clicked; providing it shows the delete button
ChipProps.onClick: Called when the chip is clicked (requires clickable)
ChipProps.disabled: Disables the chip and hides the delete button
ChipProps.deleteLabel: Accessible label for the delete button
ChipProps.clickable: Renders the chip content as a native button (focusable, activated with Enter / Space). With onDelete, the delete button is a sibling button
ChipProps.loading: Shows a spinner before the label
ChipProps.selected: Shows the selected state; on clickable chips it is also exposed as aria-pressed (when set)
